hardware: 8 physical v7x chips total,2 hosts,16 visible cores; each independent probe uses default1 device, no TP model or DCP
scope: checkpoint-free eager DEFER_NEVER baseline versus retained preceding int64/int32 metadata uploads then production CPU allocator expansion/int32 TPU upload/blocking D2H. No intermediate fencing.
acceptance: Both hosts baseline and metadata arms exact8 transfer markers; metadata arm8 numerical metadata markers; no native fatal. Passing does not exclude concurrent model/collective-dependent failure.
verified_results: Both distinct host GCS logs: baseline8 + metadata8 transfer oracles, metadata8 retained-value oracles, exact pair arm markers; no native fatal signature.
conclusion: Preceding mixed int64/int32 length/index H2Ds plus production int32 allocator roundtrip alone did not reproduce eager fatal. Do not change metadata dtype based on this hypothesis. Distributed collective/model concurrency and other queued producers remain untested.
